name: London
operatingHours: Tube runs ~5:00 AM–12:00 AM Mon–Sat (shorter hours Sun). Night Tube runs all night Fri & Sat on the Central, Jubilee, Northern & Piccadilly lines (shown on this map).
fareInfo: Tube fares with Oyster/contactless: £3.00 off-peak / £3.10 peak for a single Zone 1 journey. Daily cap for Zones 1–2 is £8.90 — you'll never pay more than that in a day no matter how many rides you take.

lines.name: Piccadilly
lines.firstLast: Heathrow⇄central London: first ~5:00 AM, last ~11:30 PM–12:30 AM Mon–Thu/Sun. Runs all night Fri & Sat (Night Tube) between Heathrow T2&3/T5 and Cockfosters — no Terminal 4 service overnight.

sights.name: The British Museum
sights.note: Free entry. Vast collection spanning world history, including the Rosetta Stone.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM daily, till 8:30 PM Fri

sights.name: Sky Garden
sights.note: Free public garden and observation deck atop the 'Walkie-Talkie' tower — book a free slot online in advance.
sights.hours: 8:00 AM–12:00 AM (1 AM Fri, 9 AM Sat/Sun)

sights.name: Natural History Museum
sights.note: Free entry. Dinosaur skeletons, the blue whale in Hintze Hall, gemstones.

sights.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
sights.note: Free entry. The world's largest museum of decorative arts and design.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:45 PM daily, till 10 PM Fri

sights.name: Westminster Abbey
sights.note: Gothic abbey church, site of British coronations for nearly 1,000 years.
sights.hours: Check official site — varies by day

sights.name: Tower Bridge
sights.note: Iconic Victorian bascule bridge with a glass-floor walkway.

sights.name: London Eye
sights.note: Europe's tallest cantilevered observation wheel, views across the Thames.

sights.name: St Paul's Cathedral
sights.note: Wren's masterpiece — climb to the Whispering Gallery and dome.
sights.hours: 8:30 AM–4:30 PM (10 AM Wed), 8 AM–6 PM Sun

sights.name: Buckingham Palace
sights.note: Working royal palace — check for Changing of the Guard times.

sights.name: Houses of Parliament & Big Ben
sights.note: Palace of Westminster and its iconic Elizabeth Tower clock.

sights.name: Camden Market
sights.note: Sprawling market — alternative fashion, street food from around the world.

sights.name: Borough Market
sights.note: One of London's oldest food markets — artisan produce, cheese, meat.

railStations.name: King's Cross St Pancras
railStations.note: Eurostar high-speed rail to Paris, Brussels & Amsterdam (St Pancras side); East Coast Main Line to Edinburgh, York, Leeds (King's Cross side).
railStations.hours: Station open ~5:00 AM–12:30 AM. Mainline & Eurostar trains run on individual timetables — no single last train. Eurostar check-in closes 30–90 min before departure, verify directly with Eurostar.

railStations.name: Paddington
railStations.note: Elizabeth Line & Heathrow Express to Heathrow Airport; Great Western main line to Bristol, Bath, Wales.
railStations.hours: Station open ~5:00 AM–12:30 AM. Heathrow Express runs every 15 min, ~5:10 AM–11:25 PM. Great Western mainline trains run on individual timetables.

airports.name: Heathrow Airport
airports.transitNote: ~45–60 min to central London via Piccadilly Line (shown on map, direct) or ~15 min via Elizabeth Line/Heathrow Express from Paddington
airports.hours: Departing Heathrow: first ~5:00 AM, last ~11:30 PM–12:30 AM most nights. Runs all night Fri & Sat (Night Tube).

airports.name: Gatwick Airport
airports.transitNote: ~30 min to central London via Gatwick Express train from Victoria (National Rail — not on the Underground map)
